children: Rail Vikas Nigam share price will remain in focus on September 7 following the company received a Letter of Award worth Rs 903 crore.

The company has received Letter of Award from SJVN Thermal (STPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of SJVN, for construction of a permanent siding along with an aerial connection via track from the Plant Boundary to Chausa and Pawani Kamarpur at Buxar (Phase-III) in Bihar for the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project (BTPP) of STPL.
The order value is Rs 903 crore and is to be completed in 36 months.
Catch all the market action on our live blog
Last week, the company emerged as the Lowest Bidder (L1) from EastCoast Railway for the project worth Rs 404.88 crore.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 212.00, up Rs 2.50, or 1.19 percent.

The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 400.90 and a 52-week low of Rs 203.95 on 29 December, 2025 and 02 September, 2026, respectively. Currently, the stock is trading 47.12 percent below its 52-week high and 3.95 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the comapny stands at Rs 44,202.43 crore.

title: Rail Vikas Nigam shares in focus on order win worth Rs 903 crore
